import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import pingouin as pg
from itertools import combinations

# ============================================================
# Analysis 1: Cross-method partial correlation
# ============================================================
data = [
    # method, ign_f1, edcr, evi_f1_tp
    ("SFT 4B s42",            0.3974, 0.6982, 0.7986),
    ("DPO-CED 1ep 4B",       0.4034, 0.7139, 0.8088),
    ("RSFT CED 4B s42",      0.4423, 0.6569, 0.8174),
    ("GRPO 4B",              0.4446, 0.6489, 0.8053),
    ("RSFT flat-NLI 4B s42", 0.4448, 0.6458, 0.8039),
    ("RSFT CED 4B s43",      0.4512, 0.6542, 0.8063),
    ("RSFT CED 4B s44",      0.4511, 0.6350, 0.8050),
    ("RSFT flat-NLI 4B s43", 0.4523, 0.6505, 0.8158),
    ("SFT 1.7B s42",         0.4786, 0.6704, 0.8316),
    ("SFT 8B s42",           0.5051, 0.6510, 0.8188),
    ("RSFT CED 1.7B s42",    0.5122, 0.6224, 0.8243),
    ("SFT Llama-8B s42",     0.5384, 0.6280, 0.8151),
    ("RSFT CED 8B s42",      0.5376, 0.6231, 0.8136),
    ("RSFT CED 8B s43",      0.5471, 0.6094, 0.8180),
    ("RSFT CED Llama s44",   0.5587, 0.5829, 0.8328),
    ("RSFT CED Llama s43",   0.5662, 0.5783, 0.8287),
    ("RSFT CED Llama s42",   0.5714, 0.5799, 0.8238),
]

df = pd.DataFrame(data, columns=["method", "ign_f1", "edcr", "evi_f1_tp"])

print("=" * 70)
print("## Cross-method partial correlation")
print("=" * 70)
print()
print("| Method | ign_f1 | EDCR | evi_f1_tp |")
print("|--------|--------|------|-----------|")
for _, row in df.iterrows():
    print(f"| {row['method']:<24s} | {row['ign_f1']:.4f} | {row['edcr']:.4f} | {row['evi_f1_tp']:.4f} |")

n_all = len(df)

# Spearman rho: EDCR vs ign_f1
rho_raw, p_raw = stats.spearmanr(df["edcr"], df["ign_f1"])
print(f"\nSpearman rho (n={n_all}): {rho_raw:.4f}, p={p_raw:.6f}")

# Partial Spearman rho controlling for evi_f1_tp (all n)
partial_all = pg.partial_corr(data=df, x="edcr", y="ign_f1", covar="evi_f1_tp", method="spearman")
rho_partial_all = partial_all["r"].values[0]
p_partial_all = partial_all["p-val"].values[0]
print(f"Partial rho controlling evi_f1_tp (n={n_all}): {rho_partial_all:.4f}, p={p_partial_all:.6f}")

# Without GRPO
df_no_grpo = df[df["method"] != "GRPO 4B"]
n_no_grpo = len(df_no_grpo)
rho_no_grpo, p_no_grpo = stats.spearmanr(df_no_grpo["edcr"], df_no_grpo["ign_f1"])
partial_no_grpo = pg.partial_corr(data=df_no_grpo, x="edcr", y="ign_f1", covar="evi_f1_tp", method="spearman")
rho_p_no_grpo = partial_no_grpo["r"].values[0]
p_p_no_grpo = partial_no_grpo["p-val"].values[0]
print(f"Partial rho controlling evi_f1_tp (n={n_no_grpo}, no GRPO): {rho_p_no_grpo:.4f}, p={p_p_no_grpo:.6f}")

# Also: 7 unique methods (one representative per method, best seed)
df_7methods = df[df["method"].isin([
    "SFT 4B s42", "DPO-CED 1ep 4B", "RSFT CED 4B s42",
    "GRPO 4B", "RSFT flat-NLI 4B s42",
    "RSFT CED 8B s42", "RSFT CED Llama s42"
])]
n_7 = len(df_7methods)
rho_7, p_7 = stats.spearmanr(df_7methods["edcr"], df_7methods["ign_f1"])
partial_7 = pg.partial_corr(data=df_7methods, x="edcr", y="ign_f1", covar="evi_f1_tp", method="spearman")
rho_p_7 = partial_7["r"].values[0]
p_p_7 = partial_7["p-val"].values[0]
print(f"\n--- 7 unique methods subset ---")
print(f"Spearman rho (n={n_7}): {rho_7:.4f}, p={p_7:.6f}")
print(f"Partial rho controlling evi_f1_tp (n={n_7}): {rho_p_7:.4f}, p={p_p_7:.6f}")

# ============================================================
# Analysis 2: Per-relation permutation test
# ============================================================
print()
print("=" * 70)
print("## Per-relation permutation test")
print("=" * 70)

with open("/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/edcr_per_relation_analysis.json") as f:
    perrel = json.load(f)

rels = perrel["per_relation"]
rel_names = []
edcr_vals = []
relf1_vals = []
for rname, rdata in rels.items():
    if rdata["tp"] > 0:  # exclude degenerate cases with no TP
        rel_names.append(rname)
        edcr_vals.append(rdata["edcr_formula"])
        relf1_vals.append(rdata["rel_f1"])

edcr_arr = np.array(edcr_vals)
relf1_arr = np.array(relf1_vals)
n_rels = len(edcr_arr)

rho_obs, _ = stats.spearmanr(edcr_arr, relf1_arr)
print(f"\nObserved Spearman rho (n={n_rels} relations with TP>0): {rho_obs:.4f}")

# Permutation test
np.random.seed(42)
n_perms = 10000
perm_rhos = np.zeros(n_perms)
for i in range(n_perms):
    perm_edcr = np.random.permutation(edcr_arr)
    perm_rhos[i], _ = stats.spearmanr(perm_edcr, relf1_arr)

# Two-sided p-value
p_perm = np.mean(np.abs(perm_rhos) >= np.abs(rho_obs))
print(f"Permutation p-value ({n_perms} perms): {p_perm:.6f}")
print(f"95th percentile of |null rho|: {np.percentile(np.abs(perm_rhos), 95):.4f}")
print(f"Max |null rho|: {np.max(np.abs(perm_rhos)):.4f}")

# Also report with all relations (including TP=0)
all_edcr = [rels[r]["edcr_formula"] for r in rels]
all_relf1 = [rels[r]["rel_f1"] for r in rels]
rho_all_rels, p_all_rels = stats.spearmanr(all_edcr, all_relf1)
print(f"\nWith all {len(all_edcr)} relations (including TP=0): rho={rho_all_rels:.4f}, p={p_all_rels:.6f}")

# ============================================================
# Analysis 3: Similar-TP different-EDCR pairs
# ============================================================
print()
print("=" * 70)
print("## Similar-TP different-EDCR pairs")
print("=" * 70)
print()
print("Criteria: |evi_f1_tp_A - evi_f1_tp_B| / max(A,B) < 0.05 AND |EDCR_A - EDCR_B| > 0.05")
print()

found_pairs = []
for (i, row_a), (j, row_b) in combinations(df.iterrows(), 2):
    tp_diff_rel = abs(row_a["evi_f1_tp"] - row_b["evi_f1_tp"]) / max(row_a["evi_f1_tp"], row_b["evi_f1_tp"])
    edcr_diff_abs = abs(row_a["edcr"] - row_b["edcr"])
    if tp_diff_rel < 0.05 and edcr_diff_abs > 0.05:
        found_pairs.append((row_a, row_b, tp_diff_rel, edcr_diff_abs))

if found_pairs:
    print(f"Found {len(found_pairs)} pairs:")
    print()
    print("| Method A | Method B | evi_f1_tp_A | evi_f1_tp_B | TP_diff_rel | EDCR_A | EDCR_B | EDCR_diff |")
    print("|----------|----------|-------------|-------------|-------------|--------|--------|-----------|")
    for row_a, row_b, tp_diff, edcr_diff in sorted(found_pairs, key=lambda x: -x[3])[:20]:
        print(f"| {row_a['method']:<24s} | {row_b['method']:<24s} | {row_a['evi_f1_tp']:.4f} | {row_b['evi_f1_tp']:.4f} | {tp_diff:.4f} | {row_a['edcr']:.4f} | {row_b['edcr']:.4f} | {edcr_diff:.4f} |")
else:
    print("No pairs found matching criteria.")

# Relax criteria to find any pairs
print()
print("--- Relaxed criteria: TP_diff_rel < 0.03 AND EDCR_diff > 0.03 ---")
relaxed = []
for (i, row_a), (j, row_b) in combinations(df.iterrows(), 2):
    tp_diff_rel = abs(row_a["evi_f1_tp"] - row_b["evi_f1_tp"]) / max(row_a["evi_f1_tp"], row_b["evi_f1_tp"])
    edcr_diff_abs = abs(row_a["edcr"] - row_b["edcr"])
    if tp_diff_rel < 0.03 and edcr_diff_abs > 0.03:
        relaxed.append((row_a, row_b, tp_diff_rel, edcr_diff_abs))

if relaxed:
    print(f"Found {len(relaxed)} pairs:")
    print()
    print("| Method A | Method B | evi_f1_tp_A | evi_f1_tp_B | TP_diff_rel | EDCR_A | EDCR_B | EDCR_diff |")
    print("|----------|----------|-------------|-------------|-------------|--------|--------|-----------|")
    for row_a, row_b, tp_diff, edcr_diff in sorted(relaxed, key=lambda x: -x[3])[:20]:
        print(f"| {row_a['method']:<24s} | {row_b['method']:<24s} | {row_a['evi_f1_tp']:.4f} | {row_b['evi_f1_tp']:.4f} | {tp_diff:.4f} | {row_a['edcr']:.4f} | {row_b['edcr']:.4f} | {edcr_diff:.4f} |")
PYEOF
